propositions: Reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of untestable, unlintable production logic in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification and alert-ticket state machines) that is a high-defect source.

Classification logic (api-error, no-success-runs, staleness window, fresh detection) and alert-lifecycle transitions (find/open/comment/close for heartbeat and binding-drift) must migrate to Python module scripts/canary_bridge.py with unit tests, while CAS push loops remain in YAML under verbatim-execution test.

The two alert-lifecycle families (heartbeat + binding-drift) require distinct error-handling dispositions: writes fail-loud (non-zero exit); dedup finds degrade gracefully; bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON signals drift (not error); DRY_RUN gates are enforced both at YAML step level and in Python subcommand short-circuits.
Anti-rot test must pin the wiring (workflow parses, steps invoke canary_bridge.py subcommands, flush loop remains byte-identical) and verify no new logic-bearing run-blocks appear.
